featured_reviews.name: Renuka Patra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I met Shivani from Event Angle at a friend's Baby shower, and loved her work and her vibe.

Hence decided to call her again when I had to plan a Baby Shower for another friend. I was working on a fixed budget and spoke to multiple decorators. What stood out for me regarding Shivani was that she was clear in her thoughts and had great inputs to give wrt designs & ideas. She understood the budget and we figured out options within that. Most importantly,  she was very professional to deal with, and always put things in writing with clarity, which was important for me.

Regarding execution, , it was exactly as we had planned and she even added some of her own inputs to enhance the whole look and feel. I was unable to be present during set-up ,but she executed flawlessly and I had nothing to worry about.

I had a really great experience working with Event Angle and their service was flawless. I'll definitely be coming back to them next time I have an event.

Thanks a tonne Shivani!

featured_reviews.name: Ayesha Nallaseth
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had such a wonderful experience with Event Angle Party Planners. My point of contact was Shivani and she nailed the brief for a  simple yet elegant & neutral baby shower that i was hosting for my sister. Her team was super efficient and they stuck to our time lines which i totally appreciate. The deco and the little games that Shivani was brief on were on point and absolutely adorable.
I think for us Event Angle Party Planners are definitely going to be a life time partnership for all our special events.
I totally recommend Shivani and her team.
Thank you guys for such an awesome experience, which will always be remembered.

featured_reviews.name: grishma kesarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had our company's 20th Anniversary and the decore which was delivered by Ms. Shivani was amazing. It was almost last minute we told her what we require and she was all ready within 3 days. Her team and she her self worked so hard to deliver the final decore which was fabulous our higher authorities really loved it. Thank you once again Shivani for the wonderful work keep it up.

featured_reviews.name: Ikshu Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Shivani and her team did a really fabulous job with our babyshower. She customised everything according to our requirements , not only the decor but also the games we wanted.The whole setup was ready an hour prior to the event starting. She even managed to arrange a host for us at the last moment and ensured complete coordination with the venue, host , DJ and stuck to the budget given without any compromise in quality.

featured_reviews.name: Amrita Bains
featured_reviews.review_text: I would rate Event Angle 5 stars for their adaptability, client satisfaction and customised decor ideas. I celebrated my parent's 25th anniversary event with them and I was very happy with the end result. Their decoration was beautiful and they executed extremely well thought out customisations. Inspite of the last minute change in the venue, Shivani and her team managed to fit the whole decor at the new venue in a matter of hours. Highly adaptable and resilient which came extremely handy at a time when the third wave of Covid hit Mumbai and multiple venues were shutting down. The photographers were as enthusiastic as us and they helped capture the night well. Special shoutout to both of them! I will surely be recommending the Event Angle team to many friends and families. I strongly suggest you give them a try too :)

featured_reviews.name: Viraj Parikh
featured_reviews.review_text: I came across this account “Event Angle” on instagram when I was looking for a decorator for a birthday celebration in an office space. It took minimal effort on my end to make Shivani understand my requirement and she was ready with the exact references I was looking at. She executed the idea beautifully and with the utmost perfection. Thank you so much Shivani for a wonderful memory. I highly recommend her service for any events or parties you’re planning to host.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Ajitsaria
featured_reviews.review_text: I really appreciate shivani ji for being so considerate and precise in her work moreover wonderful person. I very much recommend anyone and everyone to definitely plan an event stress free by Event Angel..Thank you once again for making rakshabandhan memorable. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Saurin Jhaveri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shivani (Event Angle Promoter) has conceptualised, and executed multiple birthday parties for my daughter. She always comes up ideas bang on the expectations of her clients (kids and adults alike) and adds an element of zany fun withe her creativity in decor and makes us all play games that makes us all nostalgic whilst making the most of the party. The pics are from a 7 year old birthday party where WHAT WON MY HEART over was her  engaging with kids in such a way that they actually enjoyed DIY (Do It Yourself) concept of return gifts and made they play area party even more playful with their enthusiasm :)
Thanks Shivani & all the best!! Look fwd to many more events with EA!
